purpose: Evaluate the next entry against the latest actually filled and settled episode, instead of treating flat inventory as evidence of a new independent opportunity.

implementation.same_direction: A profitable trade with a profit-type exit can establish a new confirmed breakout. Other exits require a pullback/restart structure. Both require consecutive closed-bar confirmation, not merely a new signal or elapsed time.
implementation.opposite_direction: Requires an independently confirmed break of the prior structure with volume evidence; changing BUY to SELL does not bypass the gate.
implementation.old_exit: Builds an explicitly labelled bounded POST_EXIT_ROLLING_BASE. Only later bars can establish a new opportunity; time alone does not unlock entry.
implementation.decision_evidence: Records prior episode, actual exit, net result when known, requested direction, structure path, confirmation timestamps, source freshness and immutable account-scoped controls.
implementation.configurability: OFF/SHADOW/ENFORCE, both entry directions, confirmation count, optional trigger age, structural parameters and bounded history use existing per-account controls. Frozen legacy snapshots retain their original digest.
implementation.business_state: Existing PostgreSQL evidence and account controls; no new local-file business state. This JSON is an acceptance record, not runtime state.

failure_isolation.wait_or_unknown: Candidate-local refusal with receipt/task completion, not a global trading halt; other symbols continue.
failure_isolation.context_expiry: Exact ENTRY_STRUCTURE_CONTEXT_EXPIRED classification uses existing bounded candidate expiry handling, not a broad exception bypass.
failure_isolation.close_and_reduce_only: Do not pass through the new entry gate; existing protection, exit and settlement logic remain independent.
failure_isolation.final_submit_fence: Rechecks frozen controls, evidence freshness and the actual latest prior episode under the existing account lock. No archive or model request in this fence.
failure_isolation.final_anchor_query: Savepoint with at most 500ms statement timeout and 100ms lock timeout, respecting stricter existing values. Timeout refuses submission and leaves the outer transaction usable.
failure_isolation.malformed_data: Missing, duplicated, future or non-finite candles cannot produce READY. Unknown data is not inferred from unavailable observations.

qa.runner: V2_QA_PYTHON=python3 bash scripts/qa_v2_data_core.sh -q <selected test files below>
qa.exchange_execution: Synthetic/mock exchange only; no live or Testnet orders submitted by these tests.
qa.independent_review: No new severe execution defect found. Additional malformed-provider checks rejected missing, duplicated, future and NaN bars. Review explicitly does not certify profitability or production load.
important_cases: Same-direction and opposite-direction entries both evaluated against actual previous close.
First-ever entry does not fabricate a prior exit or require history for a nonexistent cycle.
One symbol rejected while another symbol prepares an order in the same batch.
SHADOW records evidence without imposing the new veto.
Changed controls or a newly changed prior episode invalidates an already prepared open proposal.
S6 and S8 reduce-only exits bypass entry gates; full lifecycle reaches protection, close and settlement.
A real isolated PostgreSQL pg_sleep(5) anchor query is cancelled by the final fence budget and no order is sent.
TV/scanner and the workspace quant factory receive the structural wrapper; no source-name bypass.
Legacy frozen control digests remain valid; resealed malformed READY proofs are rejected.

historical_diagnostic.date_selection_utc8: 2026-10-21 through 2026-10-26, clipped to the read snapshot
historical_diagnostic.sample_digest_scope: Pair identities and original net outcomes, not a hash of all historical candle contents.
historical_diagnostic.revision_caveat: This historical run used an earlier source revision with the same 2-bar/zero-mechanical-age parameters. Its core hash differs from the final tested workspace hash; the figures are not certified as a per-pair replay of the final source revision.
historical_diagnostic.raw_report_persistence: The original JSON was returned in the task tool output, not saved as runtime state. This record retains its aggregate results and metadata, not the complete candle inputs.

opposite_direction_within_60_minutes.important_correction: All seven prior trades were losses in this sample; this does not establish a frequent profitable-close-then-immediate-reversal pattern.

historical_diagnostic.counterevidence: The proposed gate also rejects profitable trades, including the JCTUSDT 2026-10-24 18:24 UTC+8 entry whose actual net was +15.67543899 USDT. Rejected subsequent losses cannot be reported as realized savings or strategy profit improvement.
limitations: Candle archive lacks ingestion timestamps; historical availability at the actual decision time is not proven.
Actual subsequent outcomes are ex-post labels, not rule inputs or a simulation of the changed strategy.
Suppressing one trade changes later opportunities, capital, execution and the previous-exit anchor; independent pair classification does not model that counterfactual path.
This short bounded sample and retrospectively adjusted rule are not independent out-of-sample validation.
Synchronous archive coverage, source lag and candidate load need observation before runtime enforcement.

remaining_release_work: Prepare a release from the actual deployed controller, not a wholesale copy of the dirty workspace containing unrelated unpublished changes.
Repeat historical diagnostics against the final candidate source hash and retain reproducible inputs before claiming final-revision historical results.
Validate SHADOW source coverage, query latency, candidate throughput and independent close/protection progress before proposing enforcement.
Use forward/out-of-sample observations and full sequential replay including costs to test whether lost winners outweigh avoided losses.
Use fresh account/position checks and the existing graceful managed release procedure for any later restart; this record is not permission to bypass release guards.
